themes.consensus_view: Banks across more than a dozen desks flag the AI infrastructure buildout as a dominant capital-spending theme, with UBS the only desk explicitly calling new entrants the likely next market leaders while most others note the trend without staking a directional view.

facts_agreed.claim: Multiple banks identify the AI infrastructure buildout as a major ongoing capex and demand cycle.
Several banks flag AI-driven power and data center demand as a structural growth driver.
Multiple banks flag bottlenecks and overbuild risks in the AI supply chain and hardware layer.
UBS argues new entrants will likely lead the next leg of AI, since incumbents are structurally tied to legacy hardware.
evidence_quotes: new entrants will likely be among the next market leaders

themes.consensus_view: Banks agree AI spending and a narrow group of tech mega-caps are driving the entire rally, but they split sharply on whether that concentration is a durable growth story or a fragile setup primed for a sharp drawdown.

facts_agreed.claim: AI infrastructure spending remains a dominant driver of equity earnings and market performance.
evidence_quotes: strong AI spend on key bottlenecks is likely to continue to support outperformance
Mag-7 EPS growth is the strongest since Q1 '24
We expect global investment in AI infrastructure to remain robust
AI optimism is still a major catalyst
strong momentum across GPU, ASIC, general servers, and networking signals AI demand is durable
The market continues to demonstrate remarkable resilience.

facts_agreed.claim: The market rally is heavily concentrated in AI-related mega-cap tech, creating elevated concentration risk.
evidence_quotes: Without AI, the market rally would appear far less robust
environments characterized by extreme concentration can also amplify drawdowns when sentiment shifts
The outsized gains by top US tech companies have added to concentration risks
Positioning is extreme, leverage is exploding, investors are chasing low-quality tech

facts_contested.claim: Whether the AI-led rally is sustainable or set up for a sharp drawdown
facts_contested.for_evidence: Recent developments have reinforced our conviction in the long-term potential gains on offer in AI.
facts_contested.against_evidence: the only non-recession example since WWII of the S&P 500 rising this fast was a few months before a historic market crash.

facts_contested.claim: Whether AI capex funding via record debt and equity issuance is sustainable
